speaker: augustine_phillips
text: From the door, Nick. Not from the middle of the yard, where you like the sound of your own feet.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The gentleman is still speaking when I am meant to be seen. If I wait on the last word I am late, and if I come before it I tread on him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tread on him and the yard laughs at the wrong man. Wait the word. Augustine has the whistle. The whistle is the cue, not a kindness.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Again. I will give it when the line is done, and not to save thee a blush. Will, you are in this only as far as the cue. Do not improve the gentleman.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not improve him. Tomorrow I am in this. This afternoon I am not in the other, and I would like the difference kept.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Shrew does not want me. I am glad of it. She has a loud house when the groundlings are fed, and I have a bruise from Thursday's last knock.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then be glad quietly, and take the door. One.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: That was early. Your whistle came under the last word, Augustine, and I was already through.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Early is a different fault from late, and it is still a fault. Two.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Two. Hold the latch until you hear it. The latch is not a suggestion.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am holding it. The wood is hot. Everything in this house is hot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The heat is not your cue either. Listen.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: There. I was through on the breath of it, and I did not tread on him.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Three will tell. Do not smile at me as if three were already done. Back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nick, thou art quick enough when thou believest the sound. Believe it once more, and then we will stop believing and go to dinner.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Dinner is at yours, not at mine. John will have me at Aldermanbury if I am late off a rehearsal he did not attend.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then be early off it, and right. Augustine is your teacher in this room. John is your master when you are out of it. Neither of them enjoys a guess.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Three. And Will, none of your king this morning. The leaves are not in the house, and a rehearsal is not a place to miss them out loud.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not missing them out loud. I am teaching a boy a door. The king is not in this house this morning.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Then I will not look for him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not. Take the door.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Through. Clean. I did not look at my feet, which is the whole of my genius for today.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Three, and clean. Leave it. If you do it a fourth time you will invent a new mistake out of pride.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it. Tomorrow you do it once, for the yard, and the yard will not be as kind as Augustine.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The yard is never kind. It is only loud, or it is not there. I prefer loud.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Prefer what you are given. Off. Will, you are free of this afternoon. Do not come back to be useful at a play that was cast without you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am going home. Useful is tomorrow.
